desc:
🌙 WELCOME TO NIGHT RIDER

Ride down & cut through an endless, busy highway with city, industrial, farm, and suburban views.

Hop on your motorcycle and swerve through highway traffic at crazy speeds, pop wheelies & crazy tricks, and watch out for death wobbles.

CODE "RELEASE" FOR +$5K

👍 Make sure to LIKE and FAVORITE the game for more updates!

🌆 Super large highway map, stunning views
🏍️ Purchase bikes at the dealership, and do tricks
🔧 Customize your motorcycles with our detailed customization system
🎁 Daily rewards and quests
👥 Ride out with your friends
🎮 PC, Controller, Mobile

Built with quality over quantity. Updates planned by the people, for the people.

🚧 This game is in early development, expect bugs.
⚠️ Do not attempt to recreate or perform these stunts yourself.
